reviews.x: The color is true to picture. It is slightly shorter/curclier than what is depicted but I combed through it a few times and got it to loosen up. Using it for my Melisandre costume and it looks so great I kind of just want to wear it out :p

The color and style was perfect for my Black Widow costume and of good quality too. People thought I had dyed my hair red.  A real deal for the prize I paid. It was carefully packaged and it came with a hair net; saved me the trip to the beauty supply store.
Awesome quality at such a great price! I didn't expect much, but it's awesome. Co-workers thought that I'd dyed my real hair on Halloween!

This wig is a really great quality for the price - true to color and very durable so far. I'm absolutely in love with it. It shipped surprisingly quickly, too. Only con so far is that I needed a little hairspray/spray conditioner to keep the frizz down after the first wear.

This wig is amaaaaazing. True to the vibrant red color and style in the photo. I have only used it once on a client but there was almost NO shedding or tangling and it was not overly shiny. For a synthetic, this wig is absolutely wonderful and I would highly recommend any Kamo wig. The packaging is simply fabulous and you can tell that so much care was put into making sure it was going to arrive in the condition that which it was shipped. I didn't have a friz problem until about half way through wearing it, and some light product fixed it.  - I have ridiculously thick hair. Like, Galadriel ain't got nothin' on me. So wigs tend to stretch a bit more and show their netting when I put them on. This one didn't (BOOYAH). Perfect for my poison ivy cosplay.I just had some trouble with the bangs. Did tangle but I easily fixed tht by mixing some fabric softener with water in a spray bottle and spraying it on the wig. I also purchased a wig brush to get the kits out. It didn't pull as much hair out as a regular brush. I left the wig to dry overnight and it was good to go in the morning. The baby's are a little funny so I had to pull them back.
Perfect for my lite mermaid costume for this coming Halloween! Ordered August 5th, was delivered August 9th just as the delivery estimate said.

First, let me start by saying that I love this wig. The color is so vibrant and beautiful. I will say that it's a little long for my liking so I did cut it. It also doesn't look very natural, which why it's getting 4 stars instead of 5. That being said, it's so cheap that it's worth it. You get more than what you pay for. I'm sure this would be great for costumes but I just used it for everyday wear. Tips: The part is what really gives this wig away, so I generally wear cheaper wigs like this on

Fast shipping. Nicely packaged. Hair net was included with wig. Very high quality wig for the price. The color is more of a maroon. Which is exactly what I was looking for because I didn't want the color to be a "fake red." I'm using it for a Halloween costume but it could be for daily use.
Beautiful wig, it looks just like the pic. This is better quality than the typical Halloween wigs you find in stores.
I love this wig! Looks fairly natural, really pops in the light!!

reviews.t: Great wig for the price- perfect for Jessica Rabbit costume
reviews.x: Amazing quality for the price! Worked great for my Jessica rabbit costume! People asked if I had dyed my own hair! I saw others had posted similar compliments and secretly thought they were kidding. It does need a bit of taming out of the package but the bangs are easily combed and you can flat iron on a low setting.

reviews.x: I purchased this wig for a poison ivy cosplay it is very nice. It has a wig cap and adjustable straps so you can make the wig fit your head. It also comes with w wig cap. It tangles easily, but it's not hard to get the tangles out just use oil sheen or fabric softener. It's really long and beautiful.

I bought this because I wanted a wig to play The Avengers Black Widow. The official wig was lame and I wanted something I could style.  I was super happy with the magenta color- not a bright clown car red at all. While I knew nothing about styling a wig, Youtube educated me in about an hour.  Pros: This wig DOES style with a curling iron a low setting and LOTS of hair spray.  It is easy to cut, which I needed to in order for it to match the character. reviews.t: I have about 6 other costume wigs and I'm pretty picky. This wig is incredible for the price
reviews.x: I've never bought a wig online without trying it on and seeing it in person. I have about 6 other costume wigs and I'm pretty picky. This wig is incredible for the price! The texture of the wig is more like a $60 wig that you'd find in high end theater shops. The color is deep red and the curls are beautiful and stay in tact. I wore this with my Ariel Costume. It was perfect! People actually thought it was my real hair.

So, this girl likes to dress up at halloween!  I chose to be Jessica Rabbit from Who Framed Roger Rabbit.  I'd bought other wigs for costumes before, but none of them were comfortable for two hours let alone the entire day.  My red sequined dress, cartoon eyes, and red hair were the hit of the party.  You can't go wrong with this wig.  If you find my review helpful, please indicate so by using the voting buttons.

reviews.t: I got lots of compliments and it is still in perfect shape even after repeatedly getting my bracelets caught in ...
reviews.x: I have a giant head and was worried this was going to be tight.  I put it on without a cap and had issues.  Then i got the cap and put it on the actual night of the party.  It is very high quality for the price.  I got lots of compliments and it is still in perfect shape even after repeatedly getting my bracelets caught in it.  You will not be disappointed.

My second wig from Kamo and I love it. Ordered it for a Poison Ivy costume and couldn't be happier. Only complaint would be that the bangs are super long but I was able to style it fine. Longest curl reach to my bust.
Wig arrived quickly and in great shape.  It's soft which I was not expecting for such a fair priced costume wig!
Got more compliments wearing this wig than I do my own hair 😂👍 What does that tell you!
Great quality wig very thick, the color was gorgeous and the curls were to die for.
Great quality wig, I got a lot of compliments on it!

reviews.t: I’ve had this for 3 years and it still looks great 👍

reviews.t: The packaging was great - there was a cardboard protection around the wig ...
reviews.x: The wig is thick enough that you don't see the stitching.  It also came with hair net, hair band, bobby pins.  The packaging was great - there was a cardboard protection around the wig and it was in a zipper bag.The length, with curls reached below the chest but it was also straight out of the package.  Perhaps with time and gravity, the curls will lengthen more.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the wig as great quality for the price, calling it a real deal or good value.
Many say the color is true to the picture and looks natural, with people mistaking it for dyed real hair.
Several reviewers note the wig needs some taming or product to control frizz and tangles out of the package or after wearing.
Shipping is often described as fast and the wig as nicely packaged, sometimes including a hair net or wig cap.
A few reviewers mention the wig is shorter, longer, or curlier than depicted, or doesn't look very natural.
